quest.title: Memory of Stone
quest.description: Aranakula, who is said to be rather timid, has gone to the Yasna Monument, which is flooded with dangerous Fungi. Aranakula has seldom been left alone without the company of soil and seeds, so the poor little thing must need help now...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Head to the Yasna Monument and look for Aranakula

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must be Aranakula!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aaaah! A—A Nara discovered Aranakula! Wh—What should Aranakula do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't run away! Arapandu told us that you would be here!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: O—Oh. S—Since Arapandu told you, you must be a good Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? You're pretty trusting, aren't you, Aranakula? What if {NICKNAME} is a bad Nara and is using Arapandu's name to trick you?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Eh!? Th—The Golden Nara is deceiving Aranakula? The Golden Nara is a bad Nara?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, that's not... Ugh, now Paimon feels bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't listen to Paimon. I'm a good Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #So the Golden Nara really is a good Nara! That's great! Thank Aramuhukunda! Although Nara {NICKNAME} is much taller than Aranakula, Aranakula's not afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Paimon... Paimon is small, so Aranakula isn't afraid, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!

choices.text: I guess Paimon really is quite small...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'll be in trouble if you look down on Paimon! Hmph!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Getting back to the point, we're here to fix the Varuna Contraption. There should be branches and leaves of the Varuna Contraption in this part of Vana, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arapandu asked us to come here and help you in case you run into any trouble.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Oh! There are many bad guys in Vana... There is a safe road, but we must be careful. There are also bad spores everywhere. Even Nara Varuna's... *sob*

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is tall and big, and maybe as strong as Arabalika... Maybe Nara {NICKNAME} has a way...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #...Maybe Nara {NICKNAME} can help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, we came here to help out in the first place. Right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Leave it to us.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Aranakula has another request. Before fixing the Varuna Contraption... Please help find the Memory of Stone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Memory of Stone?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Vana never forgets. Aranara never forget. But Aranara leave behind memories that can be seen. Since the bad guys arrived, there have been bad seeds everywhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like Aranara always speak in riddles... Paimon guesses we'll understand when we see it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Either way, let's go there with Aranakula!

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Good Nara! Good Paimon! Let's not alert the bad guys. Use the safe road.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? The bad guys? Do you mean the Fungi? In that case, there's nothing to worry about!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe! Listen up, Aranakula, Nara {NICKNAME} is very strong!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not "very strong," but "very, VERY strong"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've already defeated many Fungi together with Arapandu! Even Arapandu recognizes our strength!

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Aranakula gets it. Nara {NICKNAME} must be as powerful as Arabalika, but what about Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon? What about Paimon?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: There was this one time when Aranakula was chased by a bad guy. Aranakula hid in the soil but got dug out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Something dripped from the bad guy's mouth. It was wet and hot and smelled like rotten fruit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: If Arabalika hadn't come in time, Aranakula would have...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Arapandu nagged Aranakula for a long time. The sun set and rose back up. Even seeds in the garden sprouted.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...That's way too long!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What does this have to do with Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, Paimon doesn't get it either.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Aranakula is more powerful than Paimon, but was still almost eaten by a bad guy. P—Paimon is so small... It's too dangerous!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Th—That kinda makes sense... Wait! You're strong, {NICKNAME}. You'll protect Paimon, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, Paimon's {NICKNAME}'s best friend after all!

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: But too many bad guys. Aranakula can't beat them... Hmm... Golden Nara is powerful, but...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Aranakula knows a safe road. We use the safe road, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Aranakula, are you especially scared of Fungi?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Ohhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Gotcha! But It's not nice to use Paimon as an excuse!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #In that case, {NICKNAME}, let's take the safe road with Aranakula. We'll take care not to alert the Fungi.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, I'm quite good at doing that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it does feel like we've done this so many times already...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Yes! Aranakula will take Nara on a safe road, then.

choices.text: You can always run away first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon won't run away and leave you behind, {NICKNAME}! Paimon won't... Paimon won't, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Paimon is very powerful!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aranara are so small, so it isn't strange for them to be scared of Fungi that are several times their size.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Paimon is not afraid?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: *sob* Aranakula is surely stronger than Paimon, but not as brave. Aranakula always hides in a <color=#00E1FFFF>safe place</color> when attacked by Fungi...

talks.objective: Go to the place that Aranakula mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, this is the Memory of Stone that Aranara have left for Nara Varuna.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're finally here... Paimon was so nervous on the way here for fear of being discovered by Fungi...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon guesses so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... So this is the Memory of Stone? It looks like a stone monument made by Aranara...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll clean up the bad seeds.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aranakula, don't worry! Just leave it to Nara {NICKNAME}. It'll be as easy as pie!

choices.text: Think of it as the process of saving up some emergency rations in the forest...

talks.objective: Clear the spores that cover the stones

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Very bad seeds. They must all be removed... Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Oh! Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Vana remembers everything that happened after Nara Varuna arrived. Big trees remember and seeds remember, but we don't know if Nara Varuna will understand...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: That's why we left visible memories. This way, when Nara Varuna returns, Nara Varuna will know that Vana never forgets and Aranara never forget.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, Paimon understands... So the Memory of Stone is a memorial plaque. Well, humans also erect memorial monuments, so that they don't forget things.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, Nara are forgetful creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Compared to the forest, Nara are like small plants that will never become towering trees. They won't ever have tree rings that remember everything...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranara won't leave Vana. Aranara will always be with Vana. But Nara come and Nara go, just like Nara Varuna.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: There are many Aranara, just like how there are many big trees in Vana. Many Aranara and many names, just like how there are many branches on a tree.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Golden Nara remembers many Aranara names and remembers that I am Aranakula. It is like picking up a floating leaf and knowing which tree it is from.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nara Varuna must also have been a special Nara to the Aranara — that's why they erected a monument for {M#her}{F#him}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's not quite the same, but we've seen statues with specific faces carved onto them before, haven't we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You mean the Statues of The Seven?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah! And now that we've heard Nara Varuna's story, {NICKNAME}, don't you want to know what {F#he}{M#she} looks like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aranara have music, so it's possible that they are also skilled in other areas! Maybe they can make lifelike statues too or something...

choices.text: I'd love to see them if they have any.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? Hehe, Nara Varuna, a Golden Nara...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, right! Guess we can go and heal the Varuna Contraption's branches and leaves now, right?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Yes. Aranakula will bring Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon there.

choices.text: Aranara art is very simple, so it's difficult to imagine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Or you know, their art could just be too advanced for you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where it was hidden. Wow, we might not have found this place without Aranakula leading the way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where are its leaves? Paimon doesn't see them.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: The leaves... They are near this big tree, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... The Fungi won't find their way in, so this place is safe. You can just wait for us here, Aranakula!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Arapandu told us we just need to make the "leaves" on the three stones turn toward the "branch," right?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

talks.objective: Make the three "leaves" turn towards the "branch"

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Once the Varuna Contraption is fixed, the bad seeds will be no more, and many flowers will grow in the nurseries...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aranakula, we're back! You'll need to handle the rest from here though.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Paimon, and thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}. Aranakula knows what to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It looks like everything will be fine here too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope the forest will return to normal soon.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: It will once the Varuna Contraption is fixed. But Marana... must be eliminated for Vana and Sarva.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Just as the monument made for Nara Varuna has been covered by bad seeds, Ashvattha's Concourses have also been affected by Marana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: There was a time before Nara Varuna came to Vanarana. Nara and Aranara made nurseries together then. But now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, only the children of Vimara Village can still see you. To adults, you only exist in stories... And the nurseries you talked about have also become deserted because of Marana...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranakula wants to fill the nurseries with flowers. Nara have forgotten Aranara, but it's fine. Nara will see the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aranakula...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, thank you. Aranakula won't forget.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranakula will return to the "rest stop" now. Arapandu will be happy to know that the monument is now clean.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Will Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon return to the "rest stop" with Aranakula?

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Traveling with Golden Nara feels so safe.

choices.text: I have something else to do.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #May Aramuhukunda watch over Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Don't get eaten by bad guys.
